title: Signature oracle-first test design
description: A Signature test-design rule: write the oracle before the generator, so every generated test has a judge waiting for it.
signature_principle: No test is generated without an oracle ready to judge it.
signature_method: Define the oracle as an executable check, then build the generator to feed it.
signature_steps: Write the executable oracle|Build the input generator|Run generator against oracle|Keep the failures as regression tests
signature_advantage: Generated tests never produce unactionable noise.

title: Signature bug-taxonomy seeding
description: A Signature fuzzing practice: seed the fuzzer with inputs shaped like the bug taxonomy of the component, so it hunts where bugs live.
signature_principle: Fuzz where the bugs are, not where the grammar is.
signature_method: Build the seed corpus from the last two years of bug reports for the component.
signature_steps: Mine the bug history|Shape seeds like past bugs|Fuzz from those seeds|File new finds against the taxonomy
signature_advantage: Finds the next bug in the family, not random noise.

title: Signature shrinking discipline
description: A Signature property-testing rule: every failure must shrink to a minimal case before it is filed, or the report is rejected.
signature_principle: A bug report with a minimal case is worth ten with a dump.
signature_method: Require the shrinker to run to fixpoint; file only the minimal case.
signature_steps: Catch the failure|Run the shrinker to fixpoint|Verify the minimal case still fails|File with the minimal case attached
signature_advantage: Developers fix minimal cases in minutes instead of hours.

title: Signature model-coverage gate

signature_method: Instrument the model; fail the build if any state or transition is uncovered.
signature_steps: Instrument the model|Run the suite|Measure state and transition coverage|Fail the build on gaps
signature_advantage: Model suites stay honest as the model evolves.
